english_text: Mr President , next week Mr Theo van Boven , the special rapporteur of the United Nations Commission on Human Rights on the question of torture , who is known for his great independence and integrity , will present his report to the United Nations in Geneva , fulfilling the mandate conferred on him . In its conclusions the report states that action against torture in Spain is no less of a pressing need today than it used to be in the past . One illustration of that was given last week when three indicted young Basques accused of transporting explosives complained of continuous torture and ill-treatment during their five days held incommunicado in the Guardia Civil headquarters . Mr van Boven said at last week 's press conference that incommunicado detention ` not only creates the conditions for torture to take place ' , the measure itself can constitute ` cruel , merciless treatment ' .
